meta.title: Web design & app development in {{city}} – Marvin Hülsmann
meta.description: Web design, website creation and app development for businesses in {{city}} ({{state}}, Germany). Personal, fast and fair – by Marvin Hülsmann, web designer and Apple developer from Berlin.
intro: I'm Marvin Hülsmann – web designer and Apple developer from Berlin. I design and build websites, landing pages and native apps for companies, freelancers and startups in {{city}} and across {{state}}.
blurb.generic: {{city}} is an exciting place in {{state}} – and businesses from here deserve a digital presence that does them justice.
services.title: What I build for {{city}}.
service.1.title: Web design & websites
service.1.text: Custom, responsive websites with Next.js and Tailwind – fast, accessible and optimised for Google. No page builder, no template.
service.2.title: App development for Apple
service.2.text: Native apps for iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and Vision Pro in Swift and SwiftUI – from concept to release on the App Store.
service.3.title: SEO & local visibility
service.3.text: Technical search engine optimisation, structured data and performance so customers from {{city}} find you on Google.
service.4.title: Consulting & support
service.4.text: Honest advice, clear quotes and support after launch. You always talk to me directly – no agency loops.
why.title: Personal instead of agency.
why.1.title: One contact
why.1.text: Design, development and support from one person. Short paths, fast answers.
why.2.title: Apple developer
why.2.text: Several of my own apps on the App Store – for iOS, watchOS and visionOS. I know how products get finished.
why.3.title: Fair & transparent
why.3.text: Fixed quotes without hidden costs. You always know what you get.
why.4.title: Attention to detail
why.4.text: Typography, motion, load time – I build things that feel as good as they look.
remote.title: From Berlin – for {{city}}.
remote.text: Most of my projects run fully remote: video calls, a shared design board, transparent updates. For a kick-off or workshop I'm happy to come to {{city}} in person.
process.title: How we work together.
process.1.title: Intro call
process.1.text: We talk for 30 minutes about your idea, goals and budget. Free and without obligation.
process.2.title: Concept & design
process.2.text: Structure, content and a design that fits your brand – before a single line of code is written.
process.3.title: Development
process.3.text: Clean implementation with a modern stack, live preview links and quick feedback rounds.
process.4.title: Launch & support
process.4.text: Release, search engine setup and support afterwards. I stay reachable.
faq.title: Common questions from {{city}}.
faq.1.q: Do you also work on site in {{city}}?
faq.1.a: Yes. Most collaboration happens remotely via video call, but for a kick-off, workshop or photos I'm happy to come to {{city}}. I'm based in Berlin.
faq.2.q: How much does a website in {{city}} cost?
faq.2.a: It depends on scope and features. After a free intro call you get a fixed quote without hidden costs – for a landing page as well as for a multilingual company site.
faq.3.q: How long does a project take?
faq.3.a: A landing page goes live within days, a complete website usually takes two to four weeks. Native apps take several weeks to months depending on scope. You see progress continuously.
faq.4.q: Do you also build apps for companies in {{city}}?
faq.4.a: Yes. I build native apps for iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and Vision Pro in Swift and SwiftUI and guide you all the way to the App Store release.
faq.5.q: Will my website be found on Google?
faq.5.a: Every website gets a clean technical foundation: fast load times, structured data, correct meta tags and mobile-first. Local visibility in {{city}} is part of the plan from day one.
nearby.title: Also near {{city}}
nearby.text: I work with businesses across {{state}} and all of Germany.
final.title: Ready for your project in {{city}}?
final.text: Tell me briefly what it's about – I'll get back to you within 24 hours.
